answer: A sonnet pledge at the meadow haven bars fake identities. At dawn the haven keeper posts the opening line of a sonnet on the meadow gate; a newcomer locks a $6 bond, then must file a couplet rhyming with that line and naming their task within the hour. Two wardens check rhyme and task against the ledger; a copied couplet, a couplet naming no real work, or a late filing burns the bond. Faking a hundred needs a hundred couplets and $600 locked.
